status: Fixed in source; frozen publication pending
finding: Runner-sync accepts an active ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP claim as a queue member and publication authority, but broker runner-sync takeover-publication previously required a conventional task ledger file. When a sealed build found pre-existing generated outputs, the only official digest-bound takeover command rejected its own queue-head task with ATM_RUNNER_PUBLICATION_INVENTORY_INCOMPLETE, creating a bootstrap dead end.
expectedBehavior: Every runner-sync recovery operation must recognize the same authority forms as runner-sync admission. A framework-temp takeover is valid only while its lock is live, its actor matches, its task is the current queue-head member, and its sealed source SHA matches exactly. Missing, expired, released, foreign-actor, non-head, or SHA-mismatched requests must fail closed.
evidenceOrRepro: Queue runner-sync-220319fe accepted ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-gpt-5-4-mini for sealed source 7c5c427d05c1e2493bb9d9fab9ee2d577a07cdd3. The sealed build succeeded but listed 30 preserved pre-existing generated outputs. The prescribed broker runner-sync takeover-publication command then failed because .atm/history/tasks/ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-gpt-5-4-mini.json does not exist, although the active framework lock and queue request did. Focused regression: tests/cli/runner-sync-framework-temp-hotfix.test.ts. Publication verified on 2026-08-14 against the runner's own declared input: release/atm-onefile/release-manifest.json at publication commit 8a3047111c7eb3673950ae719daed2801c151860 records sealedSourceCommit b3996c755027679acd995c4163fe96365f20468b with buildDecision fullRebuild and payloadReuse false, so the packed runner was rebuilt from that commit rather than reusing an earlier payload. This item cites no fix commit, so the commit was inferred rather than quoted: the last change to packages/cli/src/commands/framework-development/runner-publication-lifecycle.ts is deae056acfeaaa834d5bd220fdae1d43c508e1dc, which is an ancestor of the sealed source commit. Corroborated inside the published tree: packages/cli/dist/commands/framework-development/runner-publication-lifecycle.js at 8a3047111c7eb3673950ae719daed2801c151860 carries taskId binding. An inference is weaker evidence than a citation — whoever verifies behaviour should replace this sentence with the commit they confirm.
